description:
This protocol performs the 'Amplify Tagmented DNA' section of the Nextera DNA Flex Library Prep protocol.
Links:
 Cherrypick Samples
 Tagment DNA
 Post Tagmentation Cleanup
 Amplify Tagmented DNA
* Cleanup Libraries



Opentrons magnetic module
Bio-Rad Hard Shell 96-well low profile PCR plate 200ul #hsp9601
Agilent single-channel reservoir 290ml #201252-100
Opentrons 4-in-1 tuberack with 2ml Eppendorf tubes
P50 Single-channel electronic pipette
P300 Single/multi-channel electronic pipette
300ul Opentrons tipracks



Preprogram the thermocycler according to the BLT PCR program parameters described in the kit manual.
4x6 aluminum block tuberack (slot 4, mounted on temperature module)
 A1-C1: mastermix 1.5ml snapcap tubes (loaded empty, 1 tube needed per 32 samples)
 A2-D2: EPM in 0.5ml false-bottom tubes (1 tube needed per 24 samples)
* A3-B3: nuclease-free water in 1.5ml snapcap tubes (1 tube needed per 48 samples)

workflow.text: Add the appropriate index adapters to each sample and mix.  Seal the plate, centrifuge, and run the BLT PCR program.
